final: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT CENTROMEA AS status, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(`T-BIL` / CRE) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE Date > '1985-04-22' AND Date < '1994-03-14' GROUP BY CENTROMEA), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_avg_ratio FROM status_averages) SELECT status, avg_hgb, avg_ratio, avg_ratio / mean_avg_ratio AS relative_avg_ratio FROM status_averages CROSS JOIN overall WHERE mean_avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
